questions.prompt: What is the absolute reduction from 2% to 1%?
questions.feedback: Check the definition and explain it in your own words before retrying.

questions.prompt: How should group averages be combined?
questions.answer: Weight by relevant group sizes when calculating a pooled average.
questions.feedback: Check the distinction or calculation against the worked case; correct the first unsupported step.

questions.prompt: Does a statistically described difference prove causality?
questions.answer: No; causal interpretation requires an appropriate design and assumptions.
questions.feedback: State a concrete implication or limitation and retry without notes.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Reconstructs quantitative claims, states absolute and relative differences and qualifies inference.
scoring.transfer: Complete the quantitative problem set using one rate conversion, one model comparison, one graph critique and one claim audit. Explain uncertainties and show calculations.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
